content:
IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER – FIX HTTP 409 JOB QUEUE

Root issue:
Senior Developer requests return HTTP 409 Conflict due to overlapping jobs or stale execution state.

Implement the following:

1. Create a single global execution queue.
2. Allow only one active Senior Developer task per owner.
3. Every task must have:
   - Job ID
   - Status:
     • QUEUED
     • RUNNING
     • PATCHING
     • TESTING
     • COMMITTING
     • DEPLOYING
     • VERIFYING
     • COMPLETED
     • FAILED
4. Automatically resume an existing RUNNING job instead of creating another one.
5. Expire stale jobs after a configurable timeout.
6. Add Cancel Job and Resume Job endpoints.
7. Return the active Job ID when HTTP 409 occurs.
8. Never discard the user's request.
9. Queue the request automatically if another job is active.
10. Update Live Work in real time with current stage and progress.

Acceptance criteria:

✓ No HTTP 409 for duplicate owner requests.
✓ Second request attaches to the running job.
✓ Queue survives page refresh.
✓ Completed jobs are removed from the active queue.
✓ Every deployment returns:
- Job ID
- Commit SHA
- Render Deploy ID
- Production SHA
- Live verification
